description.value: This study investigated care-based and rule-based moral behavior in bvFTD and eAD patients compared with healthy controls, combining behavioral, neuropsychological, and MRI cortical region-of-interest measures.

spans.text: The current study sought to examine care-based and rule-based moral behavior in bvFTD and eAD patients in comparison to healthy controls.

value: we hypothesized that bvFTD patients would demonstrate more apathetic (i.e. less severe) appraisals of care-based transgressions but harsher (i.e. more severe) ratings of rule-based moral transgressions compared to eAD and normal controls.

We further hypothesized that increased ratings of severity of care-based moral transgressions would be associated with decreased cortical volume in the ATL whereas severe ratings rule-based transgressions would be associated with reductions in the OFC.

spans.text: Given prior studies in bvFTD, we hypothesized that bvFTD patients would demonstrate more apathetic (i.e. less severe) appraisals of care-based transgressions but harsher (i.e. more severe) ratings of rule-based moral transgressions compared to eAD and normal controls.

description.value: Sixty participants comprising bvFTD patients, eAD patients, and healthy age-matched controls were recruited from the Neurological Clinics of the University of California (UCLA) Medical Center and underwent MRI and neuropsychological and moral-behavior assessments.

spans.text: Sixty total participants (18 patients with bvFTD, 22 with eAD, 20 healthy controls) were recruited for this study from the Neurological Clinics of the University of California (UCLA) Medical Center.

The participants completed the Moral Behavioral Inventory ( ); the Social Norms Questionnaire ( ); Montreal Cognitive Assessment MoCA; ( ), the Clinical Dementia Rating CDR; ( ) auditory comprehension (modified from Boston Aphasia Battery) ( ) , DKEFS Proverbs ( ), Trailmaking A & B ( ), Controlled Oral Word Associates Test (FAS) ( ); Wisconsin Card Sorting Task (WCST) ( ); and Western Aphasic Battery repetition subtest ( ).

spans.text: MRI
The bvFTD and eAD patients underwent MRI using a standardized protocol on a 1.5 T high-resolution scanner.

Images were acquired in the coronal plane using an MPRAGE sequence with the following acquisition parameters: TR=2000 ms, TE=2.49 ms, TI=900 ms, flip angle=8°, slice thickness=1 mm, 25.6 cm field of view, voxel size=1.0×1.0×1.0 mm 3 .
